trace.analysis: The model over-extracted: it turned a summary range into separate records for its endpoints, and added commentary like 'not specified' to material labels. I replaced the 'list each value of a range' wording with a rule that range endpoints are context, only sample-specific values are extracted, and labels contain only stated conditions. I also added a matching self-check.

The model emitted the endpoints of a general range as separate records because the old rule said to list each value of a range; I replaced it with a rule that skips range endpoints and keeps only values tied to a specific sample or condition (explicit series values remain). I also added a matching self-check item.
